entities.name: Alistair Graye
entities.role: Anomaly and card user from the 19th century
entities.description: A mysterious time traveler from 1887 who acts like a jester, uses unpredictable cards and touch-based doubt questions, and made a past deal with Mephisto.

entities.name: Samuel Sterling
entities.description: A trained tactical agent who uses a hardened fabric tie as a combat weapon and leads operations against anomalies.
entities.quote: One man playing cards at four in the morning.

entities.name: Ayaan
entities.description: A genius technician who runs predictive combat models, deploys drone arrays, and operates an emergency combat suit.
entities.quote: I've run seventeen predictive models on his movement patterns and the problem is there are no movement patterns.

entities.name: Derek Miles
entities.description: An Ichor-enhanced operative known as Vanguard who possesses extreme speed and reflex capabilities, capable of powering through doubt.
entities.quote: Fast and strong simultaneously. That's unusual.

entities.name: Damian
entities.description: An experienced Aldercrest magician who walks upside down on architecture, wields the King and Joker cards, and corrects reality using domain magic.
entities.quote: The concrete's original state before human intervention was organic matter. I corrected it back.

entities.name: Corvani
entities.description: A commanding official at Redline who reviews surveillance data and orders operatives to investigate anomalies.
entities.quote: Go talk to him. See what he is. Bring him in if you can.

entities.name: Redline
entities.description: An operational agency that deploys tactical agents like Samuel, Derek, and Ayaan to investigate and contain threats.

entities.name: Aldercrest
entities.description: A powerful magical lineage possessing domain mechanisms, correction logic, and historical legacies.
